svg.text: How many eggs does a month of average income buy?
GNI per capita ÷ farm-gate price of one hen egg (60 g), 1950–2025 · shared log scale
Data: FAOSTAT Producer Prices (current + old series), hen eggs in shell; World Bank WDI NY.GNP.PCAP.CN (GNI per capita, current LCU); ILOSTAT EAR_EMTA_SEX_EDU_CUR_NB / EAR_EMTA_SEX_GEO_CUR_NB
(earnings by education / urban area, USD) × World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF; World Bank Pink Sheet (silver) and NY.GNP.PCAP.CD
Farm-gate prices (retail ≈ 1.5–3× higher). FAO prices begin 1966; no USSR income before 1988, no Polish income before 1990; China before 1991 and Brazil before 1983 omitted (inconsistent / too
coarse FAO units); Iran has no reliable FAO price after 1990 except 2002.
